params.caption: 🎮 Ex-BioWare lead: a new Mass Effect wouldn't need $200 million A former lead developer at BioWare says the next Mass Effect could be made for well under $200 million. In his view, that budget would be "more than enough" for the sci-fi RPG series, at a time when big-budget game costs keep climbing. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 18:07 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC #MassEffect #BioWare #GamingNews
